name: Weird Sushi
title: Tricky Story
steps: Beads Out Walkthrough [All Levels] – NEW UPDATE
Corn salad sushi → add corn + salad leaf onto rice.
Seaweed sushi → add seaweed from tank + nori sheet.
Cheese salmon sushi → add cheese + salmon slice.
Sesame octopus sushi → add toy octopus + sesame seeds.
Pork floss plum sushi → take pork floss + plum.
Ice skin durian sushi → use ice + steam to turn chef into durian, then use it on rice.
